scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Welcome to Cool Event Corp.
Our staff is always working
to surpass your expactations
for quality service. So how
may I assist you today?
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
欢迎来到酷活动公司。
我们的职员始终致力于超越您对优质服务的期望。
请问今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Your Respawn Point
has been saved here
{0}.
Thank you for using the
Cool Event Corp. service~
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
您的重生点已保存至此处
{0}。
感谢您使用酷活动公司的服务~

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you
need the Novice's
Basic Skill Level 6 to
use the Storage Service.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
抱歉，您需要拥有初心者基本技能6级才能使用仓库服务。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough Zeny to use
the Storage Service. Our
Storage access fee is 40 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足，无法使用仓库服务。
我们的仓库使用费为40泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Let me open your personal
storage for you right away.
Thanks for supporting Cool
Event Corp. by using our
services. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
我这就为您打开个人仓库。
感谢您使用我们的服务来支持酷活动公司。
祝您愉快~

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足，无法使用瞬间移动服务。
传送到{0}的费用是{1}泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchant classes.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
抱歉，手推车租赁服务仅对商人职业开放。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but the
Pushcart rental service
is only available to Merchants,
Blacksmiths, White Smiths,
Alchemists and Creators.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
抱歉，手推车租赁服务仅对商人、铁匠、 Whitesmith、炼金术士和创造者开放。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
You can only rent a cart after
learning the Pushcart Skill.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
您必须学会手推车使用技能后才能租赁手推车。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
You already have
a Pushcart equipped.
Unfortunately, we can't
rent more than one to
each customer at a time.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
您已经装备了手推车。
很遗憾，我们一次只能向每位顾客租赁一辆手推车。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
The Pushcart rental
fee is 800 Zeny. Would
you like to rent a Pushcart?
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
手推车租赁费用为800泽尼。
您想要租赁手推车吗？

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
I'm sorry, but you
don't have enough
Zeny to pay the Pushcart
rental fee of 800 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
抱歉，您的泽尼不足，无法支付800泽尼的手推车租赁费。

scripts.text:
[Cool Event Corp. Staff]
Cool Event Corp. is always
striving to provide the best
services for our customers.
Help us become the best by
providing us with your opinions
and honest feedback. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[酷活动公司职员]
酷活动公司始终致力于为顾客提供最佳服务。
请提供您的意见和真诚反馈，帮助我们做到最好。
谢谢。
